resolution.title: Skip the recent tests if the DUT version is 201911 or older.
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:

Skip the recent tests if the image is 201911 or older. These tests are added for the recent telemetry features which is available in 202012.

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Prevent false test failures for 201911 images.

#### How did you do it?
Using `pytest.skip` conditionally.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Using virtual test bed.

#### Any platform specific information?
NA
